prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. A 37-year-old woman sits at a spring celebration table with a few tulips, plain ceramic dishes, and a linen napkin, turning toward an unseen friend with a relaxed smile. Her pale blouse and natural hair feel personal rather than glamorous. Use a restrained medium portrait, luminous window light, and cream, pale green, and terracotta accents. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: a fictional woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, a fuller body and a soft round face with natural skin texture. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 1:1, square.

Continuous real photograph from top to bottom; no gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption area consists of normal clothing, furniture, floor or real foreground objects, with coherent physical boundaries. No part of a body fades away.
review: Square editorial portrait shows a blonde woman at a spring table, looking at a blurred companion. Natural skin, eye direction and chin-resting hand are coherent; tulips, ceramic dishes and linen create a real continuous lower foreground, with no fade.
